Subject: EB seat allocation & sponsor commitment roadmap — MAP + evaluation timeline

Hi Liam / Aevum team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our mutual action plan discussion I put together a compact roadmap to close this quarter: we need executive sponsor availability for the EB sessions, a short evaluation plan (3 workloads, 2 scaled runs), and confirmation of procurement milestones so we can align Dedicated capacity.

High-level asks from Aevum:
- Confirm 2–3 executive sponsors for the EB (names + roles)
- Block three 90-min EB windows across next 3 weeks (we can be flexible on dates)
- Sign off on the MAP milestones (attached: Aevum-MAP-feedback.docx)

Internal ask: Marissa / Ben / Karthik — can you review the attached MAP and the proposed evaluation checklist and call out anything that would block legal or finance sign-off?

I attached the MAP feedback you shared and a blank MAP template. I can circulate a finalized MAP + calendar .ics once we have sponsor names / confirmed windows.

Proposed EB windows (tentative):
- Week A: Apr 12–16 
- Week B: Apr 19–23 
- Week C: Apr 26–30

Next steps: Liam, if you can confirm names and any date constraints by EOD Apr 5, I’ll lock the invites and route the MAP to procurement.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Aevum-MAP-feedback.docx (summary of sponsor asks)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aevum.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@aevum.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EB seat allocation & sponsor commitment roadmap — MAP + evaluation timeline

Ava —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can commit to two exec sponsors for the EB:
- Priya Mehta, CTO
- Daniel Brooks, Head of Data Platforms

Daniel will be primary and Priya will join for the kickoff + decision checkpoint. We also need the MAP to list a single procurement point of contact — I’ve CC'd contracts@aevum.com.

Date constraints: Priya is out Apr 20–22; Daniel prefers afternoons on Apr 26–30. If you can propose a Week C window in the afternoons, that would be ideal.

I attached a short note with minor edits to the MAP.

Liam
Head of Product Strategy
Aevum Systems

Subject: Re: EB seat allocation & sponsor commitment roadmap — MAP + evaluation timeline

Quick internal sync notes and proposed sponsor allocation:

Thanks Liam for the confirmation — Priya and Daniel are perfect. I updated the MAP (attached MAP-v2.xlsx) to include:
- EB agenda draft (kickoff, two technical demos, decision checkpoint)
- Evaluation plan: three workloads (ingest latency, conversational throughput, embedding recall) with pass/fail thresholds and acceptance criteria
- Milestones & owners:
  * MAP sign-off: Aevum (Liam) + Redwood (Marissa) — target Apr 15
  * Procurement POC: contracts@aevum.com — target Apr 18
  * EB date lock: target Apr 19
  * Final decision: target May 6

A few notes: 
- Legal needs a draft SOW to estimate billing cadence — Ben, can you confirm whether we should propose monthly or milestone billing for Dedicated?
- Karthik, please confirm capacity/slotting constraints for Week C afternoons (Apr 26–30) — it may require a small burst reservation.

I propose we offer two afternoon slots on Apr 27 & Apr 29, 1600–1730 PT, pending capacity. If that works for Aevum I’ll lock invites and send the EB-availability.ics.

Marissa
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-v2.xlsx (MAP with agenda, eval checklist, milestones)

Marissa / team —

We should present milestone billing tied to decision checkpoints (kickoff, post-eval, go/no-go) — reduces procurement friction and maps to their acceptance criteria. Finance can sign off on a 3-milestone cadence. I’ll loop in finance@redwood.ai for the draft SOW language.

Ben

Redwood Inference

- EB date: Apr 27, 2027, 16:00–17:30 PT (kickoff + two demos + decision checkpoint)
- Exec sponsors: Priya Mehta (CTO), Daniel Brooks (Head of Data Platforms) — Daniel primary
- Evaluation plan: three workload runs, acceptance thresholds documented in MAP-v2.xlsx

- Liam: confirm procurement POC sign-off by Apr 18

- Ben: draft SOW milestone language by Apr 21

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the EB.
